entries.source_reference: NVIDIA CUDA C Programming Guide G.10.1 (Compute Capability 8.6): per-SM combined L1 data cache / texture cache / shared memory unified budget is 128 KiB. Carveout policy allows the runtime to split this budget between L1 and shared memory; the maximum shared allocation is 100 KiB (102400 bytes), leaving 28 KiB minimum for L1 + texture. Documented values pin l1tex_capacity_bytes at the full 128 KiB budget so the predictor head can subtract the kernel's actual static + dynamic shared bytes from it via the carveout source provenance. Note: the values published in this table are documented worst-case totals; the L1 predictor head's per-bundle l1tex_capacity_bytes is computed by the producer (orchestrator / runner) by walking the manifest's actual carveout selection and is REQUIRED to record l1tex_capacity_source so the table-derived value is auditable. l1_ways = 4 is the most-cited Ampere GA10x L1 data-cache way count from public microbenchmark studies of the GA102 SKU (citations: Jia et al. 'Dissecting the NVIDIA Volta GPU Architecture' precedent applied to GA10x; matches typical Ampere L1 microbench inference). The way count at full unified capacity (131072 bytes / 128B line / 4 ways = 256 sets) implies l1_sets_at_full_capacity=256 and the per-SM L1 functions as 4-way set-associative over 256 sets when all 128 KiB is dedicated to L1; for partial carveout (e.g. default 32 KiB L1), the predictor head proportionally scales the effective set count = (per_bundle_capacity_bytes / 128 / 4) so the per-set way capacity stays at 4. The way count is the DEC-2 model-class parameter; if a future microbench inference reveals a different way count for this SKU, update l1_ways in this entry and the predictor head will recompute set_count automatically. Provenance class: microbench_inference.
